scope: Static byte comparison between the offline reply-audio parent and offline E1 profile build. No device write or physical latency claim.

profile_semantics_from_builder.Base: original FSM once; no Direct, Auto, or Ready behavior selected
profile_semantics_from_builder.Direct: adds accepted-reply direct-audio behavior; no Auto or Ready behavior selected
profile_semantics_from_builder.Auto: Direct plus idle autopoll request path
profile_semantics_from_builder.Ready: Auto plus bounded immediate state 5 then state 7 dispatch after the original FSM pass

conclusion: The profile build does not directly replace the Highspeed handler or its selector. Static evidence supports only that profiles differ in added task/UI work; it does not prove the cause of physical responsiveness differences.
